sentences.text: 次级贷款也被称为近优级、非优级或“第二次机会”贷款。
sentences.evidence: subprime lending (also referred to as near-prime, subpar, non-prime, and second-chance lending)

sentences.text: 支持者认为次级贷款把信贷扩展给原本无法进入信贷市场的人。
sentences.evidence: Proponents of subprime lending maintain that the practice extends credit to people who would otherwise not have access to the credit market.

sentences.text: “次级”指特定借款人的信用质量：其信用记录较弱、违约风险高于优质借款人。
sentences.evidence: The term subprime refers to the credit quality of particular borrowers, who have weakened credit histories and a greater risk of loan default than prime borrowers.
